status: active diagnostic evidence; no product renderer change
scope: Bounded native observation of the S9 aggregate-GDI report and S11 temporary graphical IAT observer. This is not a claim about every real VB application or zero process-wide GDI growth.
desktop_strategy: The normal test contract remains a private desktop. For this host-only bounded diagnosis, the existing --private-worker entry was invoked directly in the executor's non-input Session 1 desktop; no common test framework or package-test fallback was retained. A self-owned probe recorded OpenInputDesktop=ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED (5), CreateDesktopW=ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED (5), WTSQueryUserToken=ERROR_PRIVILEGE_NOT_HELD (1314), and CreateWindowStationW=ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED (5), so no user desktop, existing window station, service, or process was touched.

gdi_lifetime.fixture: Self-authored x86/x64 VB5/VB6 PictureBox container fixture, two complete raw then injected lifecycle cycles in one owned process, GdiFlush after each cycle.
gdi_lifetime.x86_repeat: The same four raw/styled VB5/VB6 pairings recorded 0->2 then 2->2 (raw), and 0->4 then 4->4 (styled), with the same exact font-retirement checks.
gdi_lifetime.exact_ownership: Both styled cycles verify two distinct private font handles with GetObjectW=0 after callback retirement; source fonts remain valid; native input, image, geometry, RTL retirement, hooks, mappings and events close.
gdi_lifetime.conclusion: The observed first-cycle count is a bounded process cache effect in this fixture, not a per-cycle private-font leak. It does not establish ownership of all Windows GUI caches or cover arbitrary real VB applications.

iat_observer.instrumentation: The test-only observer now emits rejection stage, API, expected/actual address and owner, page-protection failure, compare-exchange race and exact restoration failure. It still rejects unknown hooks and does not relax any assertion.
iat_observer.covered: Self-authored graphical runtime exercised raw and injected paths on x86 and x64; one concurrent pair of x64 owned instances also passed. Each records native primitive/API behavior, style pixels, restoration and font release.
iat_observer.real_sample_limit: The optional 3Ddefline and MouseHook6 external VB6 samples both fail CreateProcessW in this non-input desktop with ERROR_ILLEGAL_DLL_RELOCATION (623), before the temporary IAT observer installs. This is not attributed to the observer or product; no failure-stage IAT record exists from this host.

remaining: A future interactive-host audit may retry the original optional VB6 samples. Graphical Check/Option, complex image variants, DriveListBox and the independent 148-unit final audit remain outside S12.
